seoTitle: Add a Symbol Watermark to Your TradingView Chart
metaDescription: Learn how to display the stock, forex, or crypto ticker as a background watermark on your TradingView chart and customize its size and opacity.
intro: A pair watermark displays the stock ticker, forex pair, or crypto symbol as a background label on your chart, making it easy to identify what you're viewing at a glance, especially in screenshots or recordings. This guide covers enabling the watermark and customizing its appearance.

steps.heading: Open TradingView chart settings
steps.body: Access the settings menu on your chart to find the watermark option.

steps.heading: Enable the watermark
steps.body: Turn on the pair watermark feature so the ticker symbol appears as a background label.

steps.heading: Customize size and opacity
steps.body: Adjust how large and how transparent the watermark appears so it doesn't distract from your price action.

steps.heading: Adjust position and font
steps.body: Set the watermark's position and font style to match your preferred chart layout.

steps.heading: Apply across asset classes
steps.body: This feature works for stocks, indices, forex, and crypto charts, so you can use it consistently across everything you track.

steps.heading: Disable or hide when needed
steps.body: You can turn the watermark off again at any time if you no longer want it displayed.

faq.question: What does the pair watermark show?
faq.answer: It displays the stock ticker, forex pair, or crypto symbol as a background label on the chart.

faq.question: Can I adjust the watermark's opacity?
faq.answer: Yes, you can customize the size, opacity, and position of the watermark to fit your chart layout.

faq.question: Does the watermark work for all asset types?
faq.answer: Yes, it works across stocks, indices, forex, and crypto charts.

faq.question: Is this useful for content creators?
faq.answer: Yes, it helps viewers quickly identify what's being analyzed in screenshots or recorded tutorials.

faq.question: Can I save the watermark setting to my templates?
faq.answer: Yes, you can save chart templates with the watermark enabled so it's consistent across your layouts.
